data.name: Ayaanat
data.gender_notes: Ayaanat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ayyina' which means 'to show a sign or indicate'. The name Ayaanat carries the meaning “Signs or indicators” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayaanat usually hope their child will grow to embody signs or indicators and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ayaanat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Signs or indicators.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayaanat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

By following these signs, Muslims believe they can maintain a deeper connection with their faith and community. This practice is deeply rooted in Islamic traditions and beliefs, which prioritizes teachings that promote a devotional and community-oriented lifestyle.
